sentences.l2: 在欧洲，印刷术发展很快。
sentences.l1: In Europe, printing developed very quickly.

sentences.l2: 很多人用印刷术传播宗教。
sentences.l1: Many people used printing to spread religion.

sentences.l2: 这种传播对宗教改革很重要。
sentences.l1: This spreading was very important for the Reformation.

sentences.l2: 宗教改革让欧洲的宗教变了很多。
sentences.l1: The Reformation changed religion in Europe a great deal.

sentences.l2: 印刷术让更多人知道新的宗教想法。
sentences.l1: Printing let more people know about new religious ideas.
